=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- agents.md:200 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The new log prefix `FINGERPRINT_POST_CAPTURE_EVOLUTION_FALSE_POSITIVE_V1` is not registered in the stable log prefixes list.
  WHY: `agents.md` says workflow-log-analysis and API-hygiene reporting depend on these stable log prefixes, so the new marker will not be detected by tooling that greps for known prefixes.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:623-638 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The pickaxe logic stops after the first well-formed `git log -S` hit and can misclassify interleaved add/remove history on the same literal.
  WHY: In branches where the string is removed, re-added, and removed again, the earliest hit may not correspond to the final removal, so the defense can accept or skip the wrong state.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:496-580 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Any parse failure or missing `captured_at` value returns `None`, causing the post-capture-evolution defense to fail closed for older fingerprint entries.
  WHY: Pre-existing `merged_issue_fingerprints` rows without `captured_at` will permanently block wave dispatch until the state is rebuilt, even when the fingerprint is genuinely satisfied at HEAD.
- tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_post_capture_evolution.py:138-150 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new regression test depends on `tempfile.mkdtemp`, which fails in the runner environment with no usable temporary directory.
  WHY: All cases abort before exercising the new defense, so the CI-wired test suite never actually validates the post-capture-evolution path.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: New regression test `tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_post_capture_evolution.py` (9 cases) covers the skip path, the fail-closed paths..., and end-to-end ref-mode. Existing fingerprint suites still pass; wired into `ci.yml`.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- File: scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py
  Line: 623-625 (in `_is_must_contain_post_capture_evolution_false_positive`)
  Problem: The pickaxe logic breaks immediately after the first well-formed result without verifying whether the captured line was re-added by a later commit.
  Why it fails at runtime: In a branch with interleaved add/remove history on the same line, the defense can produce a false negative by accepting an earlier removal that is no longer the final state.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py
  Line: 496-521 (in `_captured_at_to_epoch`)
  Problem: Any parse failure of `captured_at` (missing key, malformed ISO string, non-string value, overflow) silently returns None, causing the defense to fail closed.
  Why it fails at runtime: Older fingerprint entries predating the `captured_at` field will always fail the new defense, even when the underlying fingerprint is genuinely satisfied at HEAD.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: The `FINGERPRINT_POST_CAPTURE_EVOLUTION_FALSE_POSITIVE_V1` marker emitted by the new defense must be registered in the stable log prefixes list in `agents.md`, matching the pattern established by the existing `FINGERPRINT_PARTIAL_REMOVAL_FALSE_POSITIVE_V1` and `FINGERPRINT_STATE_SELFHEAL_V1` entries.
  Expected change site: `agents.md`, under the "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" bullet list, between `FINGERPRINT_PARTIAL_REMOVAL_FALSE_POSITIVE_V1` (line 200) and `FINGERPRINT_STATE_SELFHEAL_V1` (line 201).
  Evidence of absence: grep for `FINGERPRINT_POST_CAPTURE_EVOLUTION` in agents.md returns no matches. The stable log prefixes section lists 200+ markers but excludes this new one.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "New regression test `tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_post_capture_evolution.py` (9 cases) covers the skip path, the fail-closed paths..., and end-to-end ref-mode. Existing fingerprint suites still pass; wired into `ci.yml`."
  Expected change site: The test should pass cleanly under the CI job that runs all other `test_verify_integration_fingerprints*.py` files.
  Evidence of absence: Running the test produces 8 identical failures: `FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No usable temporary directory found in ['/tmp', '/var/tmp', '/usr/tmp', '/home/runner/work/coding-workflows/coding-workflows']`. The test uses `tempfile.mkdtemp` which fails in this sandbox environment.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- File: agents.md

The new marker emitted by `_evaluate_fp_state` at line 1204+ will not be detected by log analysis tooling that greps for known fingerprint markers, breaking the audit trail contract.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "New regression test `tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_post_capture_evolution.py` (9 cases) covers the skip path, the fail-closed paths..., and end-to-end ref-mode. Existing fingerprint suites still pass; wired into `ci.yml`."

The test file does not include defensive handling for environments where temp directory creation is restricted.

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- File: scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py
  Line: 631-638 (_is_must_contain_post_capture_evolution_false_positive)
  Problem: The loop processes only the first well-formed `git log -S` pickaxe result and does not verify that the captured line remains absent from HEAD after that commit.
  Why it fails at runtime: In branch history with interleaved add/remove of the same literal, the function can misclassify a line that was restored later, either accepting a real resolver regression or skipping a genuine violation.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py
  Line: 580 (_is_must_contain_post_capture_evolution_false_positive) and _captured_at_to_epoch
  Problem: Any parse failure (missing key, non-string, blank, malformed ISO, older fingerprints without `captured_at`) returns None, causing the defense to fail closed.
  Why it fails at runtime: Pre-existing `merged_issue_fingerprints` entries (before this field was added) or truncated state will permanently block wave dispatch on legitimate post-capture evolution until the entire fingerprint state is manually rebuilt.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_post_capture_evolution.py
  Line: 138 (_sandbox_repo context manager)
  Problem: `tempfile.mkdtemp()` with default search list fails in the CI runner (ENOENT on /tmp, /var/tmp, etc.).
  Why it fails at runtime: All 9 test cases (helper + end-to-end) never execute; the new defense is untested despite being wired into ci.yml. The `FileNotFoundError` surfaces immediately.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Add `FINGERPRINT_POST_CAPTURE_EVOLUTION_FALSE_POSITIVE_V1` to the stable log prefixes list in agents.md (matching FINGERPRINT_PARTIAL_REMOVAL_FALSE_POSITIVE_V1 and FINGERPRINT_STATE_SELFHEAL_V1) so workflow-log-analysis and API-hygiene tooling surface the new marker."
  Expected change site: agents.md under "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" bullet list.
  Evidence of absence: The prefix is emitted by the new helper and documented in README.md + verify_integration_fingerprints.py but is absent from agents.md's contractual list (grep confirms it appears nowhere in agents.md). No diff hunk updated the list.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "New regression test `tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_post_capture_evolution.py` (9 cases) covers the skip path, the fail-closed paths..., and end-to-end ref-mode. Existing fingerprint suites still pass; wired into `ci.yml`."
  Expected change site: The test should pass cleanly under the CI job (and its sandbox_repo fixture should succeed).
  Evidence of absence: The test cannot create a temp directory in the runner environment. ci.yml only added the `python3` invocation; no environment or test fixture change was made. LAST RUN DIFF and PR DIFF contain no fix for tempfile or runner constraints.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
